description: Search for emails matching criteria across one or all mailboxes. Returns message summaries with message_ref fields for use with other tools. At least one filter (from_filter, subject_filter, after_date, before_date) should be provided.

account.description: Account to search, e.g. "iCloud". Use "ALL" to search all accounts. Defaults to "ALL".

after_date.description: Only return messages received after this date. ISO 8601 format: "YYYY-MM-DD".

before_date.description: Only return messages received before this date. ISO 8601 format: "YYYY-MM-DD".

from_filter.description: Substring match on sender name or address.

mailbox.description: Mailbox to search, e.g. "INBOX". Use "ALL" to search all mailboxes in the account. Defaults to "INBOX".

name: search_emails
